programme.desc: 究竟我们可以怎样在生活和事奉里讨主的喜悦?论到《圣经》四福音书,记载了不少耳熟能详关于耶稣的生平事迹。程蒙恩长老提醒我们,可以从这些记载看到主耶稣喜欢什么,我们学习喜欢主耶稣所欢喜的事物,就可以讨主喜悦。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛》大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团、香港福音盛会、华福会香港区委会、以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生。世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位参加者,一年训练、成长、比并、同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子乔妈,人称「喜乐婆婆」,一生经历操练出一套喜乐心得,她更请来一众嘉宾好友,分享人生中大小风浪,靠著的是同出一辙的喜乐秘诀,在节目中娓娓道出那份属天的快乐。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的宝藏
programme.desc: 摄制队走访美国﹑英国﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中国及亚洲等国家,访寻学者专家多年来从大地发掘的宝藏及科研成果,当中包括高山上经历大洪水形成的奇异化石;全球首卷手抄丝绸中文圣经;以色列铸造挪亚方舟金币场等。n一切一切的资料,让观众在欣赏地球的创造同时,见证上帝的奇妙创作及精密设计,从心感受祂对我们的恩典及爱护,同时亦透过昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化问题的共同处,启示人类身为地球管理者,应该好好珍惜及保护地球的责任,改变世界,从你开始。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:三种人 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 灵修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大量的财力物力,研发新科技,要到红海的海底寻找历史证据。这集创世电视会直撀约旦,踏足每一处地方,搜罗各种铁证,带你经历摩西如何施行神迹分割红海,从埃及法老王手中,带领以色列人平安走过红海,离开埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台湾苦著名女艺人纪宝如及香港饱历沧桑的妈妈Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 福气教会讲道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康强盛的教会? 改变社区可以转化城市? 作为基督徒,我们又如何尽忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一个「幸福小组」,让教会续步履行三个使命!由台湾高雄福气教会牧者主讲,从《圣经》的话语开始,一起来学习「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#14粤
programme.desc: 有情与自称「大学生」的网友过从甚密，不停借钱给他，后来揭发有义正是那名「大学生」。高庆要有义以「大学生」的身分约会有情再吓她，但有情突然失踪。网上传来有情被绑架勒索的片段，原来是由一班女士所设的局。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#25粤普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘向令宜表示文姨娘不可能是区家内应，世显主动回家向靖远侯贺寿，实际上是为了调查黑衣人是否励行的随行；王煜酒后来到卫国公府，并与他们的管家发生争执，翌日更被发现死在卫国公附近，王家上下大为震惊。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷献上滋补的「塘虱焖乌豆」，还介绍菜式的有趣别名。乌豆带有腥味，有甚么辟腥良方？鼎爷又讲解何谓上品塘虱，并为其「盐浴」，去除鱼身的潺液。中国人爱用腌菜入馔，鼎爷带阿谭逛街市，细谈梅菜、咸酸菜等腌菜的制法，并购入榨菜，炮制「荷包蛋牛肉榨菜煲仔饭」。鼎爷示范以文武刀剁牛肉，令肉质更爽口。煎荷包蛋时，他竟自称「手腾脚震」，究竟怎么一回事？顺德之旅，鼎爷使出真功夫，让阿谭见识捕鱼古法，可有收获？

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 脂蛋白A是一种来自遗传的血液成分，即使没有三高，脂蛋白A水平过高仍会增加心肌梗塞、中风等风险。心脏科医生详析如何检测脂蛋白A水平，并介绍有助控制情况的针药，还会解说冠心病的治疗方法。粤剧演员刘惠鸣(呜姐)与港姐李尹嫣一同亮相，分享因尹嫣的母亲而缔结师徒缘分。两人致力推广粤剧，呜姐细谈怎样结合科技保育粤剧，尹嫣则忆述在英国留学时让同学感受粤剧文化的经历。「睇𩠌食饭」，陈国宾炮制「鲜虾鸡汤上海年糕」。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 怎样为健康坐姿？邓佩仪与周奕玮一组重于腰骨笔挺，而黄婧灵(波波)与吴业坤一组则选择舒适至上。请脊医讲解令椎间盘受压减少的坐姿。颈椎错位带来痛楚，有何成因及征状？嘉宾即席做出使用电脑的姿势，波波的全幅装备原来只是「做样」？脊医亦会详细分析座椅、萤幕角度等要点。椎间盘突出引致腰背痛，佩仪与波波各做出舒缓背痛的睡姿，但更似在斗骑呢！看脊医建议的平睡与侧睡姿势。另外，营养师带来一款钙质丰富的健康小食。

programme.title: 陪著你走#7粤
programme.desc: 天从和言重一起「煲剧」，但天从表示已不想看，言重隐约明白天从所指。为令天从高兴，言重向天从介绍自己是大叔模样，两人更互取暱称。加劲在电话上结识了一女子，约会后感失望。天从和导生回家时，导生行为有异……

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日

programme.desc: 玲玲姐乘无人机登场，够霸气！众姐姐为增仪式感，迅速换装古代美人以享用宫廷宴美馔，还有表演看兼有礼物带走？史莱姆是小孩爱玩的玩具，若希应熟悉，但若陪玩的不是儿女，而是一位靓仔，又会如何？玩得投入的却是祖仪！健身室都是好介绍？若希、嘉欣看到有型帅教练示范及指导，并可按次预约心仪PT后，态度即变。姐姐们还找到地方大搞池边派对，约来调酒师及猛男上门玩游戏，祖仪更似乎乐于玩输，好参与喂提子、被壁咚「惩罚」？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤

programme.title: 名媛望族#21粤PG
programme.desc: 小由往相睇，启燊阻止更向她告白；启燊把娶小由的决定告知卓万，卓万反对但被说服。心兰对小由初感满意，但知小由背景后即反对。子君向小由提出让她做启燊妾侍，小由答应。启燊得悉一切，决定要对母亲说清楚。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 「迷走神经性昏厥」这名称令人感陌生，脑神经科医生解说何谓迷走神经及其作用，再列举此症的诱发因素。昏厥时或休息片刻就能缓和，但长远而言可会对脑部造成破坏？大王、秀怡随邓达智来到商场内的溜冰场，主角却是旁边餐厅的多地融合美食！薄饼、手工意粉、日式咖喱都是其招牌菜，再加上崭新的「喇沙韩式年糕」，「达智再埋单」此行大满足。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，三姐引领大家食「蚝」啲，「姜葱蚝中蚝」集齐桶蚝、蚝豉，够豪气！

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 患乳癌风险与身材可有关系？陆浩明(六号)与队友蔡嘉欣各持己见，期间更将某重量级前辈摆上枱！留意临床肿瘤科专科医生讲解患乳癌的风险因素，也教导女士自我检查乳房的方法。问到全乳房切除手术可否百份百预防乳癌复发，张美妮、孙慧雪两位靓妈，以及六号一方均获赞讲得有纹有路，且听医生详析如何制定相关治疗与预防方案。嘉宾藉游戏带出乳癌病人手术后的饮食注意事项；中医师亦带来「灵芝补气汤」，并细谈黑灵芝的抗癌作用。

programme.title: 陪著你走#8粤
programme.desc: 导生又领天从来到言重的单位，听到<陪著你走和「爱是无所不能」广告，回想三年前之事，更恍然与言重是邻居。得知言重创作出「爱」广告，天从大为感动。加勤劝加劲致电言重，加劲拒绝。天从向言重申诉不爱跑步……

programme.title: 高朋满座#15粤
programme.desc: 妙喜喜欢以推理手法处事，厕所淤塞，妙喜决定追查到底，锁定「凶手」是有朋、有义及高庆三人，妙喜发动「家中法庭」找「真凶」，意外发现「真凶」竟是妙喜本人，是她将所有「汤渣」倒进厕所内，才令咸水渠淤塞。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#26粤普
programme.desc: 区夫人游说二娘向十一娘求助，让令宜上奏朝廷严查王煜之死，十一娘拒绝，二娘竟趁徐家举办花宴之时，披麻戴孝跪在徐家门前。令宜看在二娘份上本已打算帮忙，著十一娘暂避，但十一娘在令宽的帮忙下，成功平息风波。

programme.title: 街坊厨神舌战新台韩粤
programme.desc: 主持相约田蕊妮吃遍韩牛的不同部位及内脏，牛香四溢！他们接着发掘韩国石锅饭、港式石头饭的滋味。金刚、小仪饱餐香港得奖名菜后，在「学厨PK赛」学煮冠军级菜式「金勾银柳」，能否尽得大厨真传？

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#16粤PG
programme.desc: 有义行为变得异常，众怀疑有义正结交女朋友，有朋发现对方竟是明星Icy。杂志报道有义是为生意而出卖肉体的「保险鸭」。有朋看到有义与Icy进酒店，咬定有义不知廉耻，不知Icy与蔡公子正举行惊世记者会。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#27粤普PG
programme.desc: 令宜设计抓到杀王煜真凶，是区少夫人娘家的手下，十一娘带二娘认清真相，二娘在大哥帮助下找区少夫人对质，将事情传开；卫国公对开海禁一事态度放宽；徐太夫人希望十一娘能守护好徐家门庭，使她萌生退出仙绫阁之意。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 顺德以河鲜美食闻名，更是华南主要的馒鱼（白鳝）出口城市。鼎爷与阿谭来到顺德府右市场，果然发现顺德馒鱼肥美鲜嫩的原因。鼎爷还发挥烹饪绝学，仅以简单配料即可煮出甘香味美的「煎焗大白鳝」，并会讲解处理白鳝的秘技。炮制香滑的「蛋白杏仁茶」，「推蛋白」手势固然要正宗，鼎爷竟提到当年需要用上女士的丝袜！另一款「花胶陈皮红枣南北杏糖水」采用多种上乘食材，吃得够润够矜贵，要煮出最佳口感还要严守放入材料的先后次序。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 糖上瘾是指对甜食产生强烈渴求，即使明知过量有害仍无法控制，每日建议摄取糖分是多少？过量摄取糖分会增加肥胖、糖尿病等风险，内分泌及糖尿科医生详析饮食上的「糖衣」陷阱，并教大家聪明减糖。新手妈妈较容易患上产后抑郁，症状包括长期情绪低落，甚至出现伤害自己的念头，有哪些因素较大机会引致患病？精神科医生提醒身边人如何留意产妇有否出现异常，并带来治疗资讯。「睇𩠌食饭」，李文星师傅炮制一道「陈皮榄角煎龙趸球」。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 长时间站立容易令人患上静脉曲张，一双丝袜就可预防？郑衍峰与黄颂明及邻组的萧欣浩博士与朱智贤，分别就丝袜压力、密度展开争论。不妨听专家讲解普通丝袜与压力袜的压力值差异，再学做预防静脉曲张小运动。另外，甚么工作会增加患上腕管综合症的风险？油漆含有挥发性有机物质，其中的芳香胺会增加膀胱癌风险。两组分别挑选出髹油保护装备，有人竟戴上「潜水装备」？中医师带来有益关节的汤水；再看嘉宾大玩蒙眼拣豆游戏。

programme.title: 陪著你走#9粤
programme.desc: 天从在公园看剧时正恒突然出现，回家向天从打探，天从坦言明白正恒对自己只是放不下责任。天从独自离家，言重因听到一切不敢声张，静静跟随。言重回家，自愿替天从照顾导生。言重送回导生，担心天从有意外主动陪伴。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，滨治提议举行试胆大会，并邀请小丸子参加，小丸子一口答应，但小玉却因患感冒未能同行。小丸子在电视上看过《福尔摩斯》后，立志成为侦探，并且成功替爷爷解开明信片寄件人之谜。

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 路牌除了指示方向外，也蕴藏着本土文化设计的历史。本集「Kids’ Notes」请来研究路牌的爱好者，分享个中乐趣。嘉宾介绍一种越来越少在香港路牌上出现的「监狱体」字体，其由来确与监狱相关。他建议小朋友如想寻找这些路牌，可到沙田区多加探索。辨认时，要留意哪些细节？嘉宾与其他爱好者合作，致力将监狱体转化成电脑文字，但拍摄路牌作参考资料时却遇上不少困难。他更珍藏了一个旧式安全岛灯箱，为房间带来街道感觉。

programme.title: 魔神创造传粤日
programme.desc: 传送门关闭，阿渡等人无法回到原来世界，须佐之男告诉他们还有一个方法，便是挑战「不全部猜对就回不7」。众人最终成功通关，回到原来世界后，除了巨大的炎上弹外，还发现所有人都在为自己打气。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 西沙有新盘交楼，验楼师发现，附送衣柜没固定好，墙身也有瑕疵，质素如何？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2723粤
programme.desc: 树仁于玩游戏时遇到态度恶劣的职员，对方不肯给予他应得的礼物。树仁忍无可忍，遂表现凶恶，终令对方屈服，还得到额外奖品。原来树仁眼部不适，游戏过程中不慎触动痛处而「单起眼」，因此面目更显狰狞，令职员心生畏惧。树仁发现「扮恶」可解决不少问题，遂乐此不疲，成功以恶制恶，替不少人「出头」。然而，他似乎走火入魔，对家人亦恶形恶相，因而人见人怕。凌凌唯有设法提醒树仁，希望他能「弃恶从善」……

programme.title: Return 关节筋肌配方呈献 :守诚者#22粤PG
programme.desc: 前来拿货的周雄把钱交给巴朗，同时认出了谢庭威是员警，兰崖军团和周雄双方开始枪战。警方循著枪声冲进交易现场，希瓦为谢庭威挡枪。巴朗告诉周雄这是误会，周雄让巴朗自己处理家务事，把军火搬上厢式货车。

programme.title: 宿敌契约#17粤普PG
programme.desc: 平城骂随歌没称帝野心，说出清钰死亡真相刺激随歌，父子剑拔弩张，一笑斥平城枉为人父。庄慎被追问下说出景珩是平城所杀，庄后不可置信；慕容仲得知慕容曜与庄慎谋反，打算负荆请罪；一笑担心随歌，原来随歌就在门外

programme.title: 寻欢作乐的姐姐粤
programme.desc: 节目回到上海，凯恩与沛珈置身隐世居酒屋，获帅哥老板推介试吃横隔膜、掌心的鸡串烧，令她们也大胆起来！特别矜贵的烧提灯，口感有多「得意」？烧肉最怕麻烦，找爆肌店员帮你烧，卖点是干式熟成肉，厚实又多汁。凯恩随依婷到冲浪馆学习基本动作，为的是可穿著西装兼牵手「人气」外籍教练一起室内冲浪，姐姐立即变得型格！玲玲率众来到坐拥外滩景致的餐厅，享用专人拆肉的大闸蟹，以及考刀功的松鼠桂鱼，不时不食，味蕾大满足！

programme.desc: 卓万宣布启燊与小由婚事，子君要把喜讯通知尔嫣并接她回家。达志拒收小由礼物，更指不会出席婚礼。启烨开会，廷亨来到，表示日辉经营海砂生意，或可与他合作。日辉举行庆祝会，启烨斥尔熹反骨，卓万与尔嫣因此大吵。

programme.desc: 阿姐预备好中式圣诞大餐，款待钱嘉乐、黄智雯、虾头、胡渭康与家族成员。嘉乐胡诌拆礼物日日子及圣诞纪念屈原都中招？智雯不停举报同时不停被夹装饰，六号「应记一功」！嘉乐玩「狼人」期间不停说「梦话」，到底他来自哪个阵营？刽子手投票意愿与最终决定有所不同，造就难得的一次打和局面。嘉乐自称曾拍戏双脚裂骨，但晚上仍然到的士高跳舞，怎样可做到？虾头描述在泰国为爱被追杀的经历，阿姐却只好奇她如何认识对方及分手原因！

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【王牌律师X怪物新人法律界最强拍档真相一触即发！】在韩国顶尖律师事务所KANG&HAM，崔江锡是无人能敌的王牌律师，精准果敢、战无不胜。一次偶然，他遇见高延宇──没有法学背景、未取得律师执照，却拥有怪物般的惊人记忆力。慧眼识珠的江锡破格将他纳入团队，从此两人成为法律界最强黄金拍档。在法庭上纵横捭阖、揭露真相与阴谋，他们并肩作战，也建立深厚情谊，并在爱与抉择间踏上命运的新篇章。

programme.title: 追踪者
programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【话题冠军韩剧，正义检察官池晟孤军奋战寻找真凶！！】最强正义检察官朴政宇，被冤枉杀害妻女入狱及事件发生后失去了记忆，成为了被告人。为了洗刷背负的嫌疑罪名而不得不在狱中拼凑记忆与找出杀害妻女的真凶，这时他也进入人生最糟糕的两难选择，陷入检察官的斗争中。

programme.title: 红天机
programme.desc: 【国民妹妹金裕贞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭时旸众多男神演员！！】朝鲜时代进入景福宫的绝世美女画工红天机（金裕贞饰），和失明但可以读懂天空和星座的观象监河览（安孝燮饰），风流倜傥的亮明大君（孔明饰)，梦想成为王的周向大君(郭时旸饰)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人类的魔王同时存在展开的奇幻爱情古装剧。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 钢铁麦斯
programme.desc: 关于友谊、成长，关于正义战胜邪恶的故事。高中生麦斯的父亲意外死亡，他搬回老家，找寻父亲的过去，却意外获得超能力与一个飞行机器人，经由训练后麦斯逐渐掌握这股力量，穿上盔甲发挥潜在力量变成钢铁战士，以对抗威胁世界的神秘力量。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【王牌律师X怪物新人法律界最强拍档真相一触即发！】在韩国顶尖律师事务所KANG&HAM，崔江锡是无人能敌的王牌律师，精准果敢、战无不胜。一次偶然，他遇见高延宇──没有法学背景、未取得律师执照，却拥有怪物般的惊人记忆力。慧眼识珠的江锡破格将他纳入团队，从此两人成为法律界最强黄金拍档。在法庭上纵横捭阖、揭露真相与阴谋，他们并肩作战，也建立深厚情谊，并在爱与抉择间踏上命运的新篇章。

programme.title: 追踪者
programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.desc: 【王牌律师X怪物新人法律界最强拍档真相一触即发！】在韩国顶尖律师事务所KANG&HAM，崔江锡是无人能敌的王牌律师，精准果敢、战无不胜。一次偶然，他遇见高延宇──没有法学背景、未取得律师执照，却拥有怪物般的惊人记忆力。慧眼识珠的江锡破格将他纳入团队，从此两人成为法律界最强黄金拍档。在法庭上纵横捭阖、揭露真相与阴谋，他们并肩作战，也建立深厚情谊，并在爱与抉择间踏上命运的新篇章。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【话题冠军韩剧，正义检察官池晟孤军奋战寻找真凶！！】最强正义检察官朴政宇，被冤枉杀害妻女入狱及事件发生后失去了记忆，成为了被告人。为了洗刷背负的嫌疑罪名而不得不在狱中拼凑记忆与找出杀害妻女的真凶，这时他也进入人生最糟糕的两难选择，陷入检察官的斗争中。

programme.title: 红天机
programme.desc: 【国民妹妹金裕贞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭时旸众多男神演员！！】朝鲜时代进入景福宫的绝世美女画工红天机（金裕贞饰），和失明但可以读懂天空和星座的观象监河览（安孝燮饰），风流倜傥的亮明大君（孔明饰)，梦想成为王的周向大君(郭时旸饰)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人类的魔王同时存在展开的奇幻爱情古装剧。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - My Family
programme.desc: Monty is teased by a school friend for having a strange family and begins to wish the Kazoops were more like everyone else.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to go Swimming
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran go swimming in a lido on a hot summer day. JoJo is excited to show Gran Gran what she has learnt in her recent swimming lessons.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see a rainbow for the very first time, but it disappears so quickly! Together they decide to create a rainbow themselves from everything around them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Great Barrier Reef, Australia
programme.desc: The team dives into action as Glitch's treasure hunt endangers the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Pineapple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots & Fruits theatre, it's the magical Pineapple attempting to perform a very difficult magic trick with the help of Kiwi.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Celery
programme.desc: Live from the Roots & Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Dragon Boat Beats
programme.desc: The Supermarket is frozen over and Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Tomato practice for the boat race by using chopsticks for oars, but it doesn't go well as they're out of sync with each other.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - How to be a Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids a Supertato training film, but Evil Pea sneaks in to take over Tato Tower. The Grape Kids use the rug launcher to eject Evil Pea out of the tower.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Sleepybyes
programme.desc: The Teletubbies say goodnight to the Tiddlytubbies; it is sleepybyes time. But Po isn't tired anymore and goes for a special ride on her scooter.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - Q
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'q', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see question marks, a quilt and a queen, and even meet a quail quacking quietly!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Bubble Trouble
programme.desc: Bubbles, bubbles, all over OKIDO! Zam invents a super-strong bubble machine, but things go a bit wrong and Zim finds himself in a spot of bother.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pirate Parade
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him! Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Great Barrier Reef, Australia
programme.desc: The team dives into action as Glitch's treasure hunt endangers the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Pineapple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's the magical Pineapple attempting to perform a very difficult magic trick with the help of Kiwi.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Celery
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Dragon Boat Beats
programme.desc: The Supermarket is frozen over and Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Tomato practice for the boat race by using chopsticks for oars, but it doesn't go well as they're out of sync with each other.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - How to be a Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids a Supertato training film, but Evil Pea sneaks in to take over Tato Tower. The Grape Kids use the rug launcher to eject Evil Pea out of the tower.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Up Down, Down Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Uppy Downy. They have fun going up down, down up!

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S7) - R
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'r', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We roar, dance like a robot and see a rainbow!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Supersonic Messy
programme.desc: Okidoodle is jealous of the new RoboCar, which can go super fast! Will Okidoodle be able to catch up with the RoboCar and earn back Messy's admiration?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Dot Pursuit
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to make sure Dot doesn't see her present before her birthday party. But that's easier said than done when Dot becomes an unstoppable present-hunting machine.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Artificial Reef
programme.desc: Xuli finds a shipwreck on a coral reef and learns some glitches don't need to be fixed.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Library
programme.desc: When Muffin is told that she is special by her dad, she interprets it as an excuse to do anything she wants, which means playing Bluey and Bingo's game of library her way.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Grizzly Bear Cubs
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen &amp; Scout head to Alaska, in America, on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of fish being buried underground. Along the way, Andy meets a grizzly bear cub setting out on its first fishing trip with its mother to catch salmon.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S2) - Mission: Pop Pop
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog who loves to help people when they are worried with big soft cuddles. Sylvie and Katrina help a young boy named Alfie visit his great-grandfather.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild (S1) - Wildebeest and Monarch Butterfly
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet some wildebeest hanging out in a big group. The second animal they see, a monarch butterfly, has an astonishing wild connection with the wildebeest.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Socks
programme.desc: It's laundry day in Playtime Towers, and Bella and Lift have washed everyone's socks. All they need to do now is find the matching pairs!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Soap Opera Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels accidentally break the Chickens' TV aerial!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Mythical Creature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Puzzle Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Chichen Itza, Mexico
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch's giant ball game threatens El Castillo in Chichen Itza, Mexico, so the Go Jetters attempt to save it.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Lambert-Fisher Glacier, Antartica
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch builds his effigy in ice, his digging threatens the Lambert Glacier in Antarctica.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Gordon and Rebecca - Coming Through!
programme.desc: Gordon and Rebecca do the same work, but go about it differently, and when Rebecca tries to be more like Gordon, it doesn't go well.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Wool on Wheels
programme.desc: Scarf Lady is holding a 'knitted treats' sale in the park, but the weather is causing a problem...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Holiday
programme.desc: Seamus has booked the wrong date for his and Little Woo's holiday. Stanley repurposes the locations of the town into activities and sights to give them a holiday in a day.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Dig
programme.desc: Stanley helps Fifi and Fred dig up some shiny stones in their garden that turn out to be old bits of mosaic. With the help of Cynthia and Hettie, they put the pieces back together.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Purple Zappa
programme.desc: Monty gets a new toy robot and wonders whether it is better to keep it shiny and clean in the box or to have fun playing with it.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time For a Boat Ride
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran bump into Ned and Monty as they walk along the canal. Ned invites them onboard to go on a boat ride, where JoJo gets to act as captain - on the lookout for treasure!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Eating Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Dream Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Duggee has his dream badge, so can he help the squirrels work out what their dreams mean.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Lake Retba, Senegal
programme.desc: The team gets all shook up when Glitch sucks up the pink water of Senegal's Milkshake Lake.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Tomato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, Tomato changes colour.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Raspberry
programme.desc: Raspberry sings a song, saying it's cool to be kind.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Throne Thief
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Chilli are playing when, suddenly, they hear a scream and discover an upset Evil Pea in her freezer. Her throne has been stolen! Who would do such a thing?

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli Alone
programme.desc: Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Yellow
programme.desc: It's a special day for yellow Laa-Laa. Big yellow flowers grow in Teletubbyland and a yellow balloon leads Laa-Laa to Tiddlytubby Umby Pumby.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous "Twin Swords" in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Inviting decision makers in government, business and academia onto the show, the host encourages guests to speak their minds frankly.

programme.title: The Point with Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xin’s very own unique perspective. With two decades of experience as a news anchor and overseas correspondent, LIU Xin has an engaging and personal style. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Beginning of the End
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Dragon Knights Part 1
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Roaming Fees May Apply
programme.desc: Jims quest for Gunmars birthstone sends the gang deep into the heart of a volcano that is not what it seems and Strickler seeks to protect himself.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Blinky's Day Out
programme.desc: After the events at Gattos Keep Blinky is transformed into a human being and Jim discovers the assassin that is hunting him.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Shattered King
programme.desc: While Jim and Toby search for dates to the Spring Dance the team searches for the Second Triumbric Stone in the marshlands of the Quagawumps.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Gabby Gets The Hiccups
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a cat-in-the-box that startles Gabby, giving her the hiccups. Dr. Pandy and the Gabby Cats try several cures, but it isn't until CatRat scares the hiccups out of Gabby that they go away!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Hamster Kitties
programme.desc: When 6 adorable hamster kitties get loose in the dollhouse, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box head out to look for them. Along the way, Baby Box learns a lot about hamster kitties, which convinces Mama Box to let them live in the Craft Room.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Cat Cam
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a new camera that takes pictures with silly filters, CatRat uses it to lead Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats on a photographic scavenger hunt around the dollhouse!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - The Dark Side of the Moose: Chapter Three
programme.desc: A super-powered Rocky almost defeats Fearless Leader, but accidentally overdoes it, driving Fearless Leader to take his powers into space for the ultimate space take-over-the-world evil plan

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What's The Funny Little Creature In The Pond?
programme.desc: Jess is looking after Horace's underwater friends in the pond whilst Horace is away. He sees a funny creature with a round head, a long tail and a little mark on his nose. "What's the funny little creature in the pond?" Hey! That's the Big Question! The creature has vanished so Jess describes it to Mimi who draws a picture of it. Mimi, Joey and Jinx think it must be a fish and name him Freddie, but Jess is not so sure. Time passes and Jess doesn't see Freddie again for ages.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Keep Dry For Horace's Concert?
programme.desc: Horace has planned a big musical show but before it can start it begins raining and everyone runs for shelter. How can we keep dry? Asks JESS - that's the Big Question. Jess, Baa and Billie find shelter under some vine leaves. They're keeping dry but they're too far away from the pond to watch the show. Jess thinks that maybe they could wear a hat to keep dry - Baa's hat is soft and lets the water in though so that's no good but it gives Jess another idea.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Cheer Up Kevin?
programme.desc: JESS, and his friends are looking after Kevin the carp while Horace goes to visit a friend. They decide to clean out HORACE'S pond for him and take all the yukky pond weed to the river where the hungry fishes gobble it up. But when they get back they find that KEVIN is unhappy in his pond. "How can I cheer up Kevin?" That's the Big Question. First JESS thinks that KEVIN might be lonely so they take it in turns to keep him company. But KEVIN seems even more unhappy than before.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Decorate The Christmas Tree?
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve on Greendale Farm. Jess is very very excited. Every year Mimi decorates the special tree in the woods and the friends all gather around to sing and play and open presents. But when Jess, Mimi and Willow arrive to leave presents at the tree they're shocked to see that the wind has blown all the decorations away! How dreadful! - How will they celebrate Christmas with no decorations? And Mimi can't help as she and Willow have promised to deliver presents outside the farm.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Make The Trolley Go Faster?

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP1
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP10
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP1
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP7
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP9
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP13
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP4
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP10
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP15
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.desc: 致力于打造成为企业数字化转型与数据资产建设的核心服务载体。通过充分发挥空间集聚与纽带功能，积极整合技术、资本、人才等产业要素，构建协同共生的服务业数据产业生态。平台旨在系统性解决企业在数据应用中的实际难题，助力企业真正实现“有数可用、有数敢用”，持续赋能业务创新与高质量发展。

programme.title: 直播丨Bio+学院“扬帆出海”系列主题直播课·第八期 扬帆拓海 药通全球
programme.desc: 为助力本土企业精准把握国际药政新动向，打通创新药械海外注册全链条，构建符合国际标准的临床试验质量管理体系，本期直播课聚焦新形势下上海创新药出海的战略布局、临床试验管理与注册实操，集结复宏汉霖、泰格医药、辉瑞三大头部药企的相关领域专家，深度解码出海核心难题，为企业国际化征程提供“精准导航”。\r\n上海市生物医药产业教育培训平台“Bio+学院”联合行业龙头企业和知名专家,倾力打造“扬帆出海”主题系列直播课,将从政策法规、行业规划、产品准入、市场监管等方面,为企业深度答疑解惑,促进跨境交流，推动多边合作。\r\n后续敬请期待!

programme.title: 2025全球数商大会｜数链生态 智启未来——第二届区块链创新高峰论坛

programme.title: 直击业绩会｜微软2026财年第一财季业绩会
programme.desc: 微软(MSFT.US)于美东时间10月29日盘后发布第一财季报告，公布的支出增幅超出华尔街预期，引发了市场对人工智能基础设施高成本的担忧。报告显示，在第一财季，微软总营收增长18%，达到777亿美元;每股收益为3.72美元。分析师此前平均预期其营收为756亿美元，每股收益为3.68美元。

programme.desc: 这是一座介于乡村与都市间的迷你化、可爱化的小城镇-东閰镇。里面住著许多东方传说中的人物、妖怪以及拟人化的动物。故事主人翁閰小妹是东閰镇镇长的独生女，就读东閰国小三年级，班上有各式各样的妖怪同学，还有一位来自西方的留学生迪米欧。迪米欧和閰小妹两人成为一对有趣的搭档，产生出许多好玩的趣事。在东閰镇里，每天可以认识许多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每个角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被发掘。閰小妹将带领著迪米欧与同学们在东閰城里一起学习、一起探险，也将引导观众，重新认识华人文化里，最具奇幻魅力的异想世界。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1668集
programme.desc: 人间卫视【生活智多星】邀请到「好门媳妇」－郁方担任主持人，透过轻松活泼的访谈，让您成为生活上「智多星」。本节目邀请不同领域的专家学者，从科学的观点，深入浅出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑虑与似是而非的伪知识，了解事情的源由与真相，提供不一样的想法与见解。【生活智多星】内容丰富多元，例如针对银发族的需求，邀请银发族运动专家，将因久坐而气滞血瘀的沙发马铃薯大变身，强力打造出活力四射、充满元气的不老传说。以及有关吃的大哉问：吃进嘴里的是营养还是毒药，吃的顺序、吃的方法与吃的健康，从不吃坏肚子到吃到强身健体，【生活智多星】全面关心。

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 艺次元宇宙第266集
programme.desc: 音乐人田定丰除了跨足文创和摄影，斜杠有成的他将携手人间卫视，开一个电视新节目──「艺次元宇宙」，邀请艺术领域的意见领袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 说人解字第19集
programme.desc: 以100多位历史人物为主题，共说了近400则的成语故事，这些耳熟能详的成语，出自数百年甚至是千年前，包括孔孟老庄、李白、杜甫、曹操、刘备……等上百位真实的、虚构的人物。以特有的说书方式，讲述这些人的生平以及相关成语典故，轻松逗趣却又寓意深远。

programme.title: 遇见一首诗第37集
programme.desc: 寻找一首诗，遇见一首诗，在爱的热望里，在典范的仰望下，在社会关怀的悲悯叹息声中。诗人教授带你品读，进入现代诗的迷人世界。

programme.title: 生活快易通第15集
programme.desc: 节目邀请到大家熟悉的「万人美老师」－郭昱晴担任主持人。以系列为节目核心，邀请在相同体系内，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其坚守追求专业的精神与受挫不懈的毅力。并且将依照不同专业，结合生活观点，推出相符的小单元。内容兼具权威与风趣，不仅拉近观众与来宾距离，也从中看到来宾不为人知的另一面。如节目中热血仁医系列，除了分享医生在白色巨塔中奋斗的故事之外，也会依其专业，在预防医学的概念下，加入医疗科技新资讯及独门养生撇步等小单元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第2集
programme.desc: 此音只应天上有，人间哪得几回闻。」「梵呗」就是清净之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心灵的清净，歌咏时还伴以管、弦或敲击乐器，普及佛教教义。

programme.desc: 人间卫视【生活智多星】邀请到「好门媳妇」－郁方担任主持人，透过轻松活泼的访谈，让您成为生活上「智多星」。本节目邀请不同领域的专家学者，从科学的观点，深入浅出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑虑与似是而非的伪知识，了解事情的源由与真相，提供不一样的想法与见解。【生活智多星】内容丰富多元，例如针对银发族的需求，邀请银发族运动专家，将因久坐而气滞血瘀的沙发马铃薯大变身，强力打造出活力四射、充满元气的不老传说。以及有关吃的大哉问：吃进嘴里的是营养还是毒药，吃的顺序、吃的方法与吃的健康，从不吃坏肚子到吃到强身健体，【生活智多星】全面关心。

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 说人解字第20集

programme.title: 阿母第38集
programme.desc: 母亲简称母，或称妈妈，是一种亲属关系的称谓，是子女对双亲中的女性的称呼。母亲和子女是重要的直系亲属关系之一，通常具有亲密关系。一般指生育小孩的女人（即生母）；但在有些状况下，仅养育小孩（养母），或再婚配偶（继母）、结谊长辈（义母），或是仅提供卵子让精子与之结合（代孕母）（例如捐卵等辅助生殖技术），但并未亲自生育小孩的女人也可如此称呼。

programme.title: 葬送的芙莉莲第24集
programme.desc: 魔法使芙莉莲与勇者欣梅尔等人一同经历了10年的冒险，最终打倒魔王，替世界带来了和平。芙莉莲身为活了千年以上的精灵，她与欣梅尔等人约好再次相会后，便独自踏上旅程。在那之后过了50年，芙莉莲造访欣梅尔的所在地，但她与50年前长得一模一样，相较之下欣梅尔已经老去，早已时日无多。之后，芙莉莲亲眼见到过世的欣梅尔，深深体悟自己至今都没有去「了解他人」，对此感到懊悔的她，决定「为了了解他人」而踏上旅程。

programme.title: 热海恋歌第1集
programme.desc: 父母亲早逝的英雄，从小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次乡里冲突，英雄和换帖兄弟添财离家北上，进入温泉乡~北投，当起限时专送的机车小弟。在北投，他遇见今生唯一的挚爱秀秀。拥有天生音乐才华的他，最初学习各种乐器只是为了讨秀秀欢心，最后却因此成为名扬北投的「春风」那卡西乐团乐手。可惜两人纯真的恋情，却遭秀秀的养父所反对，英雄却不放弃；纵使在得知秀秀已与日本商人白原订婚之后，英雄仍不死心，继续穿梭在温泉乡崎岖的巷道与繁华的酒宴间，弹著为秀秀所谱写的未完成歌曲，无畏地向全世界宣誓，他要倾尽一生的光阴来爱秀秀…。在秀秀与白元的婚礼上，英雄冲到美川阁，想带秀秀远走高飞！毕竟深爱著英雄的秀秀，身著婚纱、不顾一切坐上他

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第399集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第27集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第176集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集

programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 行动现场第435集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 法譬如水第481集

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第27集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 法譬如水第483集
programme.desc: 当灾难成为日常，纷乱的世界迫切需要人心的调和，携手共度难关。大爱电视特别推出《法譬如水—证严上人讲述水忏》，透过佛法智慧引领观众反思人心与环境的深层连结。证严上人以清凉法水涤除心垢，将经典智慧化为实践指南，让佛法不再遥不可及，而是化解当下困境的明灯。唯有人心净化，天地才会和谐。

programme.title: 法譬如水第484集
programme.desc: 当灾难成为日常，纷乱的世界迫切需要人心的调和，携手共度难关。大爱电视特别推出《法譬如水—证严上人讲述水忏》，透过佛法智慧引领观众反思人心与环境的深层连结。证严上人以清凉法水涤除心垢，将经典智慧化为实践指南，让佛法不再遥不可及，而是化解当下困境的明灯。唯有人心净化，天地才会和谐。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第37集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大爱学汉医第308集
programme.desc: 让世界看懂中医，打破中医的框架迷思，发挥预防重于治疗的优点，让台湾走向乐活社会。

programme.title: 人间菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分钟， 证严上人以佛心应世事，结合台湾社会脉动、全球趋势，从后山看世界。

programme.title: 大爱年度剧展-芳草碧连天第8集
programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6707集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第595集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 股林高手第14集
programme.desc: 独创胜率极高的〝型态操作〞，以技术分析为主，搭配题材面、筹码面、财务面交互判断的一种逻辑分析。能够更明确的洞悉法人大户筹码，并且辨别骗线

programme.title: 价值型投资第14集

programme.title: 金钱道第14集

programme.desc: 灵龙天曜怀著满心喜悦准备和广寒门掌门素影成亲，谁知素影另有图谋，她计划取龙鳞制一件龙鳞铠甲，为护她真正所爱之人不伤不死，却不想天曜拼死在最后一刻将凝聚巨大灵力的护心鳞打出，素影大怒，将天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。护心鳞飞跃山河，落入了一心口缺失的弃婴雁回胸膛，填补了雁回心脏缺失，让她得以活命。十年后，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌门凌霄收养，纳入辰星山成为他的弟子。因识海未开，灵力全无，仍是一星弟子，因此被同门嘲笑。一次偶然的机会，触发了雁回心口护心鳞的力量，灵龙之火瞬间烧毁了锁妖塔的结界，塔内的妖族趁机逃跑。凌霄得知后将其赶出辰星山，雁回误解了师父，觉得道不同不相为谋，便潇洒下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 包青天第183集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 遇见祝福第20集

programme.title: 真情部落格第767集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: senay345第2季:第212集
programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，「族语童谣里述说的是我们的根」，全新型态的儿童少年节目《senay345》，将透过活泼创新的儿童音乐节目形式，提供不同族群孩童一个享受展演的舞台。每一集会邀请二位孩童，在节目中演唱族语歌曲，听著小朋友说著族语故事，透过童趣的自然对话与互动激发创作力和表达能力，一起感受到纯粹快乐自然的沉浸在族语世界里。

programme.title: pito pitju mpitu’ 7个为什么?第1季:第53集
programme.desc: 我们去学校上课啰！ 这一季我们带著六个动画人物走进校园，去到教学阿美语、排湾语、泰雅语、布农语还有太鲁阁语的五个族群语言的学校，跟著族语老师与小小朋友们一起上课、一起唱歌，呈现俏皮与新颖的族语教学方式。在课堂中认识书写文字的发音，还有复习每集的主要单字。

programme.title: Kari Snruwan纪时光第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 带你踏上充满魅力的兰屿岛，深入了解雅美（达悟）族独特的文化传统。 你知道吗？当长子诞生，父母与祖父母都必须改名，这不仅是一项命名规则，更是对家族传承的尊重与延续。节目中，我们将跟随耆老的脚步，聆听他们故事传递的生活智慧，从出海捕鱼到追踪山猪，学习在大自然中生活的哲理，一起感受随兴自然的岛屿节奏，邀你一同感受岛屿文化的纯粹与感动。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第27集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍
